process.h2: How White Glove Movers Work in Boston

steps.title: List the Special Pieces
steps.text: Tell us which items need extra care, with rough sizes and anything you know about their condition.

steps.title: Plan the Handling
steps.text: A manager prices the move and the crew plans how each piece is wrapped, carried and loaded.

faqHeading: White Glove Movers FAQ for Boston Customers

faq.q: What do white glove movers in Boston do differently?
faq.a: They add protection and planning for pieces that can't take an ordinary carry: extra wrapping, upright packing for art and mirrors, and a planned route for oversized furniture.

faq.q: Can I book white glove handling for just a few items?
faq.a: Yes. Most customers add white glove handling for a handful of pieces inside a regular home move, on the same quote.
Yes. Antique furniture is a large part of our white glove work, wrapped so finishes and joints are protected in transit.

faq.q: How do you pack framed art and mirrors?
faq.a: We wrap each piece and pack it upright, the way frames and glass are meant to travel, never flat under other items.

faq.q: How is a white glove move priced?
faq.a: A local white glove move is billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added. Extra care takes extra time, and the manager explains that when they price your move.

faq.q: Should I tell you about a piece's condition before the move?
faq.a: Yes. Loose joints, old repairs or flaking finishes change how the crew wraps and lifts a piece, so mention them when you request a quote. Photos help the manager plan the handling and the time it takes.

faqClosing: Still have a question about moving valuable pieces? Our FAQ page covers billing, booking and moving day.
